title: XP Script Editor Window is Too Big

posts.author: ZZMario
posts.body:
(This might be a problem with my computer settings, but idk)
I moved from using RPG Maker XP with WINE on an old Linux (Ubuntu) computer to a new Windows one (I'm running Windows 11 Home), and when reinstalling XP, it worked fine. I like to script in my projects, so I was expecting the script editor window to be the same size as it was back on Linux, but it wasn't. The entire bottom area of the window goes off the screen, and even if I drag it, it doesn't work, and I need the bottom of the window for the Save, Cancel, Apply, and OK buttons, which I cannot access because of the issue.
Here's my screen dimensions for both:
Linux Laptop (old): 1365 x 767
WINE Settings (Linux Laptop, so XP would work, all I sacrificed was the taskbar it worked perfectly): 1500 x 768
Windows Laptop (new - has error): 1536 x 864
These are the two properties for XP that I have enabled (was me trying to fix it myself)
- Compatibility Mode for "Windows XP (Service Pack 2)"
- Override High DPI scaling behavior
Neither of these worked.
I've also tried ResizeEnableRunner, but it doesn't work with the Script Editor window for some reason.
That's mostly all that I've done so far.
Anything else that I could try, or is it just stuck this way?
Here's what it looks like:
​
Here's XP on the WineDB by the way
and I know I'm trying to run some really old software on a big laptop but I have a project I want to continue and it would be very hard to port it to another engine

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Up to Windows 10, you wouldn't face such a complex issue. At least that's what I think because I could run on on a laptop with a screen size similar to your old one, and it run on both Linux & Windows 7 easily. Later on I got a PC with Windows 10 and got 2 monitors. The first one I think it was 1440x800 I think, and nothing weird happen. It turned out to be a VERY old monitor so I had to buy a new one that's Full HD. It still works fine on both, Linux & Windows.
Honestly, I think the script editor looks small in higher resolutions up to 1080p and even higher. I'd have bet that the High DPI was the issue. Now I think I'm out of ideas. Is there any other "old" app or game having similar issues with missing bars or buttons?
EDIT: I asked you that because sometimes you can't get a direct answer for some RM issue, BUT other apps might have faced the same situation in the past, and they might have a clue on what's happening on your PC or laptop.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
I think this is a problem with something in the computer settings--I've got XP running on Win11 and it fits the screen fine.
My display is 1920x1200, and the scale is 125%. I think I installed it in compatibility mode for Windows XP (Service Pack 3), but that part seems like it wouldn't make much difference for this particular problem.
Can you try setting a different resolution for your display, rather than the 1536x864?

posts.author: ZZMario
posts.body:
Yeh that screenshot is basically what it looked like when I used WINE, just then the header bar was different.
I did set different resolutions (and scales), but pretty much the entire application window size stayed the same. I tried this both with and without the service pack.
And no, there isn't, this is the only app I know of that is old doing this
